reviews.comment: irritated.
Dr. Cahill is always happy to answer questions and explains things well (coming from someone who had no prior coding experience).

ENGR 102 is all about coding, so if you've never done it before, it's going to be difficult, but possible to do well. Dr. Cahill ensures that students feel confident on the topics, as evident when he starts the class with "Any questions?" He does read off the slides, which can get a bit repetive. Overall, he's a good professor and gets the job done

good lecturer, reads mostly off of slides but would give his own opinion or add jokes to make the class fun. hes an amazing guy, class is annoying. make sure you dont rely on your group too much, learn the code, tests are tricky but lots of materials and resources are given to you, no practice tests

He was a very good lecturer; mostly read off slides, but would add his own insight and if he didn't know a coding question he'd go to python and test it. Class is definitely make or break with your project group, so try to find a good one on the first day; assignments are 50/50 individual vs group work. Very open to questions, WOULD take him again
reviews.ratingTags: Group projects--Clear grading criteria--Lots of homework

reviews.comment: Regardless of your professor, the majority of what you learn will be from completing assignment in the Zybook. DO NOT let your group carry you. I had zero prior coding experience but worked through all of the assignments  and did great. Tests can be tricky and you may bomb a quiz, but Dr. Cahill is super helpful and caring if you have questions.
This professor is awesome!!! Would highly recommend. He's so funny and so chill and a very fair grader. No complaints.

Dr. Cahill is a very good professor. Compared to other 102 classes, there is less homework. He is very caring, funny, and patient. He is also good at clarifying anything and answering any questions. The class is mostly graded based on homework, many quizzes, and the two tests.

Cahill itself is a great person and professor, makes his lectures extremely funny and enjoyable. With no prior coding experience, class was definitely challenging and help was difficult to access. Weekly group and individual assignment along with quiz (in-class). Hard to ask him for help, but can always point you in the right direction.
The lectures were fun, he made a lot of dad jokes. Do the work when it's assigned, and make sure you learn how to code. Besides that, you're chilling.

Willing to help students individually during class lab times. Gives lots of advice about things that aren't necessarily related to the class and can be distracting. Willing to move/extend deadlines if requested. A reasonable professor and super nice. Be prepared for time-consuming homework and lots of group work.
Good professor, unfortunately, didn't give a lot of feedback. The TAs didn't give great feedback too.

He is a really great teacher. Had him for my fall 2021 semester and he taught so well, plus or TA's were very good as well. Pay attention to slides as the quiz questions are from there or similar to it. MId term and final were really hard but he curves. If you keep focusing on your labs, you will ace this class.

Dr. Cahill put absolutely no effort into this class and he knew that we all knew it. We had two assignments all semester and he didn't grade them until after we took the final. If you want an easy A for 216 or 217 but don't care about learning anything, take Cahill. Labs are graded by TAs though, so make sure you actually do the work for those

I had Cahill b4 and he was great, fall 2021 was different however. He didn't put in any grades until the absolute last second, gave no review/info for the final, he said he would curve the final to a B and when the average came back (a 65%) he just didnt curve. He blamed everything on the physics dept and the TA's and took zero accountability.
Best prof I could ask for. Makes it a point for everyone to learn and have fun during lectures. Also, extremely lenient when it comes to attendance, minus the in person tests.

Professor Cahill is the best professor you can get for this class. He only gave us a few homeworks so most of the work came from the lab. You did have to study for the final on your own so prepare review sheets for the final as you go. Other than that, the homework grades were posted before the final but the difference is a good PTA for lab.

Although a little forgetful and often behind schedule, Cahill is a solid choice for ENGR102. Labs and lectures are pretty straightfoward and they grading pretty easily on labs (I think the TA grades those though). Exams aren't too bad, they are mostly just simple applications of class material that you can get through by practicing different codes

I took Cahill this past semester as my first engineering class, and he is the prof you want to take. He will basically tell you how to code a problem if you just ask him for help either at the beginning of class or in office hours. He really cares about his students and said if he knows your face and name, you will not fail his class.

Not an especially great professor, but he did enough to make the class easy. Most of the exam material was covered in lectures, so show up, but the lab meets were optional. The labs were graded pretty lightly, and your entire grade is based on the labs and the exams. Exams aren't impossible but tough for an intro class but wasn't a hard A to get.
Great professor. The class was chaotic this semester and all the labs were graded on the last week though. The curriculum seems pretty scattered as well but this could all be due to COVID.

For ENGR102, Dr. Cahill was a great professor. He didn't require a lot of time to be spent in class. During lectures, he would be entertaining and would answer any questions asked, even about future classes/specific engr majors, which is very helpful for freshman deciding which branch on engr they want to go into. Highly recommend for freshman.

Dr. Cahill is a great professor and truly cars about the success of all of his students. The entire PHYS 217 class is crazy since the departments are still trying to figure out what to teach us. But Cahill made sure to get lots of feedback and definitely wanted us to learn the information that was being taught. Would definitely take again.

Dr. Cahill is a really great guy who is easy to talk to. As long as you do the assignments you will have no problem doing well in the class. I would strongly recommend Cahill for freshman engineering courses.

Cahill is great, probably the best prof for this class. The class is lab heavy, 70% of the grade. Labs were in groups of 4 and were graded generously. The lab instructions were quite vague and grades took forever to be put in. The final is only 15% but was difficult, all material from the lectures on powerpoint slides. Take Cahill if you can.
Best Professor I have had all freshman year in Engineering!!!

Very fun professor, he was entertaining during class yet still got the message through clearly. Always willing to answer any questions he can (even ones not related to class). With no previous coding experience the class was a bit rough for me but I enjoyed attending class. "Pop quizzes" were every Thursday.

Professor Cahill is an amazing choice for ENGR 102. He is kind and helpful in class and responds to questions over email quickly. Having some programming background helps quite a bit, but if you don't the Zybook explains things pretty well.

Best 102 professor!!! I loved his class and he was super nice. He had no problem giving students extra time if something was obviously effecting the whole class and he made his lectures interesting. Would highly recommend Cahill!

Professor Cahill is amazing! Very chill, laid back, and understanding. He tries to make lectures interesting and easy to understand, and is more than willing to help/ go out of his way to help students that have questions or don't understand. I hope I get him again next semester!

Engineering 111/112 is a huge mess of a class. He knows his material and is a really chill dude. However, the homeworks that are assigned can have issues handling errors (coding). Not to mention there are only two tests in the semester. TA's do not know what's going on and you have no materials to study for the test. Good luck general engineering.

Dr. Cahill is the best ENGR 111 and 112 professor out there. He makes sure you understand the material. He tries to keep the classes hands-on and interesting. Matlab may be a pain but he makes it easier. He also understands the pointlessness of LabView. If you make an effort to participate, he will remember you. 10/10 Professor. Would Take Again.

One of the best profs, really cares about his students. Good lectures, daily ICA, and short homeworks. Very funny, gives great examples, lots of classtime to ask questions about coding and anything in engineering. My only complaints are that it takes a long time to get grades back and we dont get feedback on homework/ICAs once graded.

Dr. Cahill is an understanding professor that is always ready to answer questions and give you a little extra help when you need it. He's a good lecturer, being completely honest (and a little funny) and covering all the important topics. The only "downside" to this class is that it can take awhile to get homework and other grades back.

Cahill is the best professor you could have for ENGR 111/112. He knows a lot about every major which is very important for the entry to major process. He skims over stuff, but will explain later if needed. ENGR 111 is pretty much busy work with coding until you enter a major. Overall, he is a very kind and understanding person, but the class sucks.

Engineering 111 is a very tough class. I suggest you not take it unless required. However, if you have to take the course, take Cahill. He's the best one for the course, a respectable professor, but it's a really tough course. Luckily, tests are not weighted that much but you still have to overcome the obstacle of group projects. Little to no hw.

Moves pretty fast during class but will slow down if you ask him to. He's really attentive to his students and will answer any questions that you have. The only downside is that his assignments can be pretty tough, but he gives you a good amount of time to complete them.
reviews.ratingTags: Gives good feedback--Participation matters--Skip class? You won't pass.

reviews.comment: Cahill is a real bro, super nice prof! Would really recommend.

He is really caring and an all round great prof. He's the head of the department and also a Civil Engineering prof. To add on top of that, hes been doing the stuff we learn since before we were born so he's a big help in class. 10/10 would recommend.
